title: KestrelCare Repair Facility Timelines: Authorization, Invoice Submission, Payment and Recovery
content:
KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts give repair facilities and the claims desk fixed timelines. The figures are the same at every coverage level.

| Coverage level | Facility must obtain authorization before starting a repair | Facility invoice due (calendar days after the repair order date) | Facility paid (business days after approval) | Payment made in error recoverable (calendar days after the claim payment) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| KestrelCare Powertrain | yes | 30 | 2 | 180 |
| KestrelCare Powertrain Plus | yes | 30 | 2 | 180 |
| KestrelCare Silver | yes | 30 | 2 | 180 |
| KestrelCare Gold | yes | 30 | 2 | 180 |
| KestrelCare Platinum | yes | 30 | 2 | 180 |
| KestrelCare Platinum Exclusionary | yes | 30 | 2 | 180 |

## Notes on the columns

- **Authorization.** On every KestrelCare level the facility requests authorization before work begins on the repair.
- **Invoice submission.** The facility invoice is submitted within 30 calendar days after the date of the repair order.
- **Facility payment.** An approved claim is paid to the facility within 2 business days after the approval.
- **Recovery window.** A claim payment found to have been made in error can be recovered within 180 calendar days after that payment.

## Boundary illustration (hypothetical dates)

A repair order dated 1 June has its invoice due no later than 1 July, the thirtieth calendar day after the repair order date. A claim payment made on 5 January falls 180 calendar days later on 4 July of the same (non-leap) year, the last day of its recovery window; on 5 July it is outside it.
